FAQ

Selling surplus paper rolls

What paper rolls do you buy?

We buy unprinted rolls of thin gauge paper first and foremost: natural and bleached kraft, white and colored tissue, thermal print paper, wet strength paper and board in white 1S or 2S. We also buy rolls of coated, laminated, poly coated, silicone coated and metallized paper.

Which industries do your paper rolls come from?

We buy rolls from paper mills (stocklot, coated and uncoated), flexible packaging converters, laminators and slitters, food and beverage packers, and PSA tape and label makers with surplus release paper.

Do you buy printed or colored paper rolls?

Colored paper is fine. Our main interest is unprinted paper, but we also look at printed rollstock, so send us the details.

Do you buy coated paper?

Yes. Paper coated or laminated one or two sides is in demand. Just ask, and tell us the coating and basis weight if you know them.

How do I sell my surplus paper rolls?

Send us the grade, width and basis weight if you have them, plus the gross weight on hand, the pick-up location and a few photos. As your roll buyer, we'll come back with a proposal.

How fast can you pick up?

We pick up full and partial trailer loads of surplus rolls across North America, usually within 48 to 72 hours.
